what: A new blaze lint with a fix needs its suggestion applied and the result linted again clean, but the helpers that do it lived private to std_mistakes' tests, built on that module's own fixture, so a lint elsewhere would copy them.
cost: a third copy of the apply-and-relint helpers, or a lint shipped with its fix untested
cause: the helpers were written for the first lint that needed them, in its own test file, with its fixture baked in
class: test machinery every lint needs kept beside the one lint that first needed it
prevention: the crate's test module owns every helper that takes a fixture and flags (lint, lint_with, suggested_in, offered_in, fixed_in); a lint's test file only builds its fixture
fix: crates/blaze-lints/src/tests.rs suggested_in, offered_in, fixed_in; std_mistakes/tests.rs offered and fixed delegate to them; magic_tests.rs uses them (uncompiled at the time of writing)
